title: Hornsdale Power Reserve: South Australia-Victoria Separation: Preliminary Incident Report
summary: AEMO reported Hornsdale Power Reserve's fast response during the November 2019 South Australia-Victoria separation event. Phase 56E entity use: Event response and installed capacity remain distinct from offered service capability, compliance, availability, and value.
key_findings: The asset's rapid output contributed to arresting frequency movement during the event.
Entity layer: Hornsdale grid-scale battery in South Australia.
Compatibility boundary: Stable asset identity; event response, compliance intervals, and installed capacity are not one performance series.
